name: hcapp_uncancelDownDown
description: Clears the cancelled flag on a DownDown charge (IsCancelled = 0), restoring it to pending. Does not touch IsDone. Idempotent — an already-pending charge succeeds. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 61, standard token). @kennelId, @eventId and @downDownId all required (NULL or all-zero → 1234 / errorType 2). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageDownDowns' for @kennelId (GM / RA by the data-driven matrix) → else 1337 (errorType 3). The UPDATE is keyed on id + EventId + KennelId; no row → 4041 (3). No transaction (single statement). New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Used as auth scope and as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the DownDown belongs to. Used as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: downDownId
parameters.description: DownDown to restore to pending. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. If no DownDown matches downDownId + eventId + kennelId, returns errorCode 4041, errorType 3. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the error detail at index 1. ValidateAppAuth codes; 1234 missing parameter (2); 1337 not authorised (3); 4041 DownDown not found (3); 1933 unhandled (5).

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on successful uncancel: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.
Returned (at index 1) alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled error.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.DownDowns SET IsCancelled = 0, UpdatedAt = GETUTCDATE() WHERE id = @downDownId AND EventId = @eventId AND KennelId = @kennelId (no explicit transaction; single statement).
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors.

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: IsCancelled column is BIT in the table, not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: HC.DownDowns.IsCancelled is declared as BIT NOT NULL. The project standard is SMALLINT. SQL Server implicitly converts the integer literal 0 used in the UPDATE. Dart callers must handle this as a JSON boolean, not an integer.

codeSmells.issue: Not-authorised uses errorType 3 and the CATCH code 1933 is shared
codeSmells.detail: Line 90 reports a permission refusal as errorType 3, the same family as 'DownDown not found' (4041); other SPs use 13. Line 132's 1933 is shared with hcapp_cancelDownDown, hcapp_addDownDown and others, so a log row cannot name the SP by code alone (ProcName does).
